units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 25:7">Targ. Deut. XXV, 7</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 39b:9">Yeb. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אי בעית יַיבֵּם</he> if thou so desirest, marry her.
<cite ref="Yevamot 39b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>אי צבית ליַבֵּם יַבֵּם</he> if thou consentest to marry, marry.
<cite ref="Yevamot 31b:15">Ib. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ונְיַיבֵּם לחדא וכ׳</he> let him marry one and &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: , contr. אִיַּיבֵּם as preced. Hithpa. Ib. 30ᵇ לִיַּיבּוּמֵי (= לְאִיַּי׳) to be taken in marriage by the yabam. Ib. 32ᵃ תִּתְיַיבֵּם יַבּוּמֵי let her be taken &c.; a. e.
